product_contract.primary_surface_rule: Stats primary surface must stay operator-useful and workshop-led; repetitive resolved ledgers belong in secondary surfaces.
product_contract.secondary_surface_rule: Detailed QE resolved rows, compare/debug tooling, and repetitive ledger dumps must be isolated from the default operator workflow.

contract.missingness_rule: Do not backfill missing canonical QE rows from line_verification or input_dashboard context payloads.

unique_text.prefix_text: Killing a boss or elite grants 5x tower damage for
unique_text.suffix_text: seconds; a new valid kill refreshes timer rather than stacking multiplier.

unique_text.prefix_text: Multiply wall HP and wall regen by
unique_text.suffix_text: factor, and for repeated wall-thorns hits on same enemy add +1% wall-thorns damage taken per subsequent hit.

unique_text.prefix_text: Spawn
unique_text.suffix_text: number of Electrons. On Electron hit, deal 15% of current remaining HP, multiplied by 0.25 against Bosses and Fleets.

unique_text.prefix_text: Increase each bot range by
unique_text.suffix_text: meters and apply 2x damage-taken state to enemies hit by Flame Bot.

unique_text.prefix_text: For each free-upgrade trigger during current wave, add
unique_text.suffix_text: to temporary coin/kill bonus for that wave, excluding Tower Range increases as valid triggers.

unique_text.prefix_text: Spawn one extra Black Hole and, while enemies are inside any Black Hole, reduce their outgoing damage by
Retarget Spotlight to the boss and cause reflected light around that boss to increase nearby enemies damage taken by
unique_text.suffix_text: multiplier.
